items.title: 13.11 Pani ki safai mein chlorine ka istemal (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 13.11, printed page 301.

blocks.text: Chlorine gas bohat zehreeli hai. Lekin thori miqdar mein yeh insanon ke liye be-zarar (nuqsan na dene wali) hai, jab ke bimariyan phailane wale bacteria ke liye zehreeli hai. Apni mazboot disinfectant (jaraseem maarne wali) properties ki wajah se chlorine pani saaf karne ke treatment plants mein bohat istemal hoti hai. Is tareeqe mein chlorine pani mein dali jati hai, jahan yeh active species (asar karne wale ajza) banati hai jo bacteria aur doosre pathogens (bimari paida karne wale jaraseem) ko maar deti hain. Swimming pools ka pani bhi thori zyada concentration ki chlorine se chlorinate kiya jata hai, kyun ke us mein bacteria zyada hone ka imkan hota hai. Bunyadi active species chloric (I) acid ya hypochlorous acid (HOCl) aur chlorate (I) ya hypochlorite ion (OCl⁻) hain. Chlorination pani ko jaraseem se paak karne ka nisbatan sasta tareeqa hai.

blocks.prompt: Pani saaf karne mein chlorine istemal karne ka ek nuqsan batayein.
blocks.explanation: Chlorine pani mein maujood organic maddon se react kar ke chlorinated by-products (jaise trihalomethanes) bana sakti hai, jin mein se kuch sehat ke liye nuqsan-deh samjhe jate hain; pani ka zaiqa aur boo bhi badal sakti hai. Chlorine gas khud zehreeli hai, is liye ise ehtiyat se rakhna aur istemal karna parta hai.

items: Thori chlorine insanon ke liye be-zarar magar bacteria ke liye zehreeli; pani saaf karne ka sasta tareeqa.
Active species: HOCl aur OCl⁻; swimming pools mein zyada miqdar.
